stories.title: Conflict and conservation: How AI is being leveraged to protect Malaysian wildlife
stories.synopsis: In Malaysia, AI is helping to keep elephants away from farms and to detect orang utan nests in remote forests. WWF Malaysia has been researching the nest-detection tool in Sabah since 2023, because sprawling forests make orang utans hard to monitor. Better and faster information can help conservation teams plan and protect habitats.

stories.title: A Sweeter Future? AI Helps Scientists Discover New Sugar Substitutes
stories.source: American Friends of the Hebrew University
stories.synopsis: Researchers at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem combined machine learning with molecular modeling to screen more than 50 million chemical compounds. They narrowed the field to 92 promising candidates for future sugar substitutes. Many have chemical structures unlike known sweeteners, which hints at entirely new kinds of sweet-tasting compounds.

stories.title: An AI-Based Drug Discovery Tool Goes Beyond Protein Structures
stories.synopsis: Researchers developed Ptarmigan-1, an AI tool that can screen the so-called dark proteome against over a billion drug candidates in a day. It predicts protein-drug interactions without needing a protein's fixed 3D structure, which opens the door to proteins once considered undruggable. In the study, it identified successful drug candidates that a co-folding model could not.
